answer: Bind each agent identity to a unique vertex in a proof-of-personhood graph, where reputation accrues only after independent peers seal its work with their own cipher keys. A seal requires a stake that peers lose if the sealed work is later disputed, so colluding clones must fund many stakes at once. Bridge rules require seals from agents that already hold distinct reputation paths, blocking closed rings. Faking that costs more than farm rewards, so clone farms lose money.
